tasks.title: Publish validated location uptime and bounded JSON mutations in contract 2.2.0
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Behavior and Checks bullets, Tool facts and Completion evidence; Decisions 1 and 3; Contract fields; Counterexamples (Statistic, Sorting and uniqueness); Security impact. Keep the two additive interfaces in one library release. Implement the location schemas, types and same-object nonthrowing validator; requestJson POST/PUT/DELETE with status/value/etag/wire, bounded optional ErrorResponse.error, manual redirects, no retry and fetchJson-compatible interruption/check ordering; preserve fetchJson behavior. Export the new interfaces, compile the type fixture, release package 2.2.0 with wire 1, rebuild and commit dist, and document both interfaces.

acceptance.expected: All selected tests pass, 0 fail; focused coverage may fail the global threshold. Literal eu {good:4,results:5,uptime:80} and us {good:0,results:0,uptime:null} are accepted; duplicate/unsorted names, windowDays 30, negative/fractional counts, good 4/results 3 and inconsistent nulls are rejected; the validator returns the original object without throwing. Fake-fetch tests prove method/body/content-type/manual redirect, 201 JSON, 204 and empty-body undefined values, raw ETag, 412 ErrorResponse text, 500 non-JSON without message, 302 http error, size/JSON/validation/wire failures, timeout/caller abort/network and exactly 1 fetch call for every requestJson case. Existing fetchJson tests still pass, including absent-wire policy and http errors without message.

exit 0; lint, build, type fixture and the full test suite pass with the existing 80% line coverage gate. CheckLocationUptime, LocationUptime, RequestJsonOptions and RequestJsonResult compile as public exports; package version is 2.2.0 and WIRE_VERSION remains 1. PR evidence includes this output and the new tests failing on reviewed main 9ab7e24 for missing exports before passing on the change.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the regenerated dist artifacts have been staged or committed; rebuilding produces no unstaged dist drift. Record the Security impact checklist evidence applicable to the library: own-data error properties, response cap default 5242880 bytes, error-text bound 1000 characters, no redirects/retries and no added runtime dependency. Include the check and build output in the PR.
